rule: The channel games that need a scorebug check to be dated (docs/research/P8_FEASIBILITY.md section 4). A game becomes a development game (status confirmed) only when one frame's scorebug (teams, period, game clock, score) matches the play-by-play of exactly one candidate SportVU game in the contract (score at that clock). The 4 broadcast CV test games are not listed here: their ids live only in reports/research/testset.json. Every id here passes tools.research_testset.refuse_cv_test.
